migration_note: v2 exists solely to fix a content-sufficiency defect found while diagnosing counterfactual_collector_canary_v1_20260727T145126Z: the v1 lexical prior (token_overlap/sqrt(doc_token_count)) has no lower bound on doc_token_count, so near-empty documents (e.g. SciDocs records with an empty text field) can outscore substantive documents and capture the pool -- measured at 10/10 and 7/10 pool slots for the two frozen SciDocs queries, versus 0/10 for fiqa/hotpotqa/bright. v2 changes ONLY candidate_pool.pool_protocol_version (lexical_prior_pool_v1 -> lexical_prior_pool_v2: a bounded-denominator prior plus an explicit pre-scoring document-validity gate). Datasets, frozen query ids, prompt, judgment schema, provider panel, policies, and call budget are unchanged from v1. rendering_policy_version is unchanged (title_plus_prefix_truncate_v1); the audit found no independent rendering defect, only a pool-selection defect. v1 remains frozen and reproducible; this is an additive new version, not an edit to v1's meaning.

establishes: candidate pools with an explicit document-validity gate
does_not_establish: retrieval quality superiority of the bounded-denominator prior over v1 (not evaluated against qrels; selected purely on qrels-blind operational properties -- see docs/benchmarks/COUNTERFACTUAL_PILOT_FREEZE_V1.md v2 addendum)

candidate_pool.max_candidate_chars_note: Unchanged from v1 -- the audit found no independent rendering defect, only a pool-selection defect.
candidate_pool.pool_protocol_note: Qrels-blind lexical-prior pool with (a) a bounded-denominator primary prior (overlap / sqrt(max(doc_token_count, 25))), removing v1's unbounded reward for near-empty documents, and (b) an explicit pre-scoring document-validity gate (nonempty body text; >=15 alphabetic tokens; >=100 substantive characters -- thresholds derived from the 1st-percentile nonempty-body length across all four frozen datasets) that excludes degenerate candidates before scoring, with every exclusion recorded alongside the valid candidate that replaced it. Still not a canonical multi-ranker/RRF pool. Selected over raw token-overlap, plain Jaccard, an RRF fusion of the two v1 priors, and an approximate BM25, using only qrels-blind operational properties (title-only/near-empty concentration, determinism, no unbounded reward) -- not qrels-based retrieval quality.
candidate_pool.rendering_policy_note: Unchanged from v1: deterministic title+text composition then prefix truncation to max_candidate_chars.

call_budget.formula_note: 8 queries x 4 providers x 8 pairs = 256 initial calls
call_budget.token_cap_derivation_note: Unchanged from v1 -- same prompt, same 1,200-char truncation cap, same providers.
